title: Exterior Painting in Gainesville, FL | Siding & Stucco
description: Exterior painting in Gainesville, FL for wood siding, stucco, brick, and trim. Mildew wash, rot repair, acrylic or elastomeric coats, up to 10-year warranty.
heroIntro: Gainesville exteriors fail from the bottom edge and the sunny side first. We price and prep each elevation for what it is actually facing, then coat it to last.

sections.h2: Siding, stucco, and brick across Gainesville
body: Walk the Duckpond or Pleasant Street and most of what you see is wood clapboard carrying coat upon coat of past paint, plus brackets, rails, and window casings to cut in around. NW Gainesville bungalows mix wood or fiber-cement siding with masonry. Out in Haile Plantation and Town of Tioga, the newer houses are mostly stucco or fiber-cement boards trimmed in painted wood.

We match the coating to whatever it is going over: 100% acrylic for clapboard, lap siding, and trim, elastomeric for stucco that has started to hairline crack, and a penetrating stain on any wood you want left natural. Brick and block walls get coatings made for masonry.

sections.h2: Reading each elevation during the walkthrough
body: Your crew lead circles the Gainesville house with a camera and a moisture meter, testing any board that gives under a thumb. The checklist on that walk:
bullets: Chalky film on the south and west faces, where UV eats the binder first
Peeling at the lowest siding boards and door frames from sprinkler spray and splash-back
Green and black growth on walls that never see afternoon sun
Open joints around windows, trim, and penetrations
Soft fascia and sills that need replacement before paint

sections.h2: Prep and paint on a Gainesville exterior
body: We book separate days just for preparation. First comes a wash with mildew treatment; then flaking paint is scraped until the edges stay put, shiny areas are scuffed with sandpaper, popped nails are reset, and decayed wood is cut out and replaced. A flexible, paintable sealant goes into joints that move, and primer is spotted onto bare wood and fine stucco cracks.

Finish is two full coats from the premium Sherwin-Williams or Benjamin Moore lines, and we add a third when you are jumping to a very different color or the surface drinks paint. Wherever we spray, a painter follows with a brush or roller to push the coating into the grain and texture.

Our preferred season for Gainesville exteriors runs October to May. Summer exteriors still go ahead, with crews arriving early, reading the dew point, and keeping the radar up for the 3 p.m. storms. Expect three to seven working days of painting on a full house, plus the wash and the time it takes to dry. Wondering how many years a good exterior should give you? Our article on how long exterior paint lasts in Florida lays it out.

sections.h2: Finishing a Gainesville exterior: punch walk and warranty
body: Your exterior comes with a written workmanship warranty of up to 10 years, which sits on top of whatever the manufacturer covers. The punch list gets your signature only once each item on it is done. Add a soft wash in Gainesville for the sidewalk and driveway while the crew is there, or read the broader exterior painting service page. Our painters in Gainesville page covers the neighborhoods we work in most.

faqs.q: Will you repaint a stucco house in Haile Plantation or Town of Tioga?
faqs.a: Yes. If the stucco has fine cracks, we usually finish it in an elastomeric coating that flexes across them; anything wider than a hairline is patched first.

faqs.q: Can you match my community's approved exterior colors?
faqs.a: Yes. Give us the approved chip or let us sample an existing wall, and we will make full-size drawdowns you can attach to your HOA's approval request.

faqs.q: What if you find rotten wood during the job?
faqs.a: Anything the crew lead spots during the walkthrough is already priced in your estimate. If hidden decay turns up once boards come off, we show it to you and do nothing about it until you approve the extra work in writing.

faqs.q: How much does exterior painting cost in Gainesville?
faqs.a: There is no published price list. Your number comes from the measured square footage, the condition of the house and the prep it needs, which product line you choose, how high and accessible the walls are, and how many colors are involved. The estimate costs nothing.
